tickets.title: Add refund button to order page
tickets.outcome: Support staff can start a refund from the order page.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order paid within 30 days, when a support agent opens it, then a Refund button is visible.

tickets.title: Show refund status on the order page
tickets.outcome: Agents see whether a refund is pending, paid or failed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refund in state pending, when an agent opens the order, then the badge reads Pending.
